warnings: Structural specification for the whole house. Key values for joining onto elements: concrete ค.3 with fc' >= 210 ksc at 28 days; ø6 and ø9 bars are ROUND SR-24 (fy >= 2400); ø12 and above are DEFORMED SD-40 / SD-40T (fy >= 4000).
The SR-24 / SD-40 split is by DIAMETER, not by element. Any element with ø6 or ø9 stirrups and ø12+ main bars therefore mixes two steel grades -- record steel_grade per bar, not per element.

Foundation type is soil-dependent as in house 06, but the threshold and pile differ: here it is 6 t/m² (not 8), and the pile is a SOLID SQUARE 0.22x0.22 m at >= 3.0 t safe load, 6.00 m assumed for pricing (house 06 used a hollow hexagonal 0.15x0.15 at 1.7 t). Item 3.3 requires choosing one system throughout.

Floors are PRECAST SOLID PLANK (SP) 5 cm thick with a 5 cm structural topping reinforced ø6@0.20 or WIRE MESH ø4@0.15 (fy >= 5270), designed for >= 300 kg/m² live plus finishes. This is a new element type not seen in house 06.
Item 5 confirms structural steel is present (fy >= 2400, arc-welded, two coats of lead-oxide primer) -- consistent with S-15's title about fixing steel beams and rafters to RC columns.

The 'ø' symbol is used on this sheet for BOTH round bars (item 2.1) and the square pile dimension (item 3.1, 'ø0.22x0.22'), where it cannot mean a diameter. Transcribed verbatim; the pile is square per the words 'สี่เหลี่ยมตัน'.

NORMALIZED_2026-08-02(r5): element entries without element_id were given one - from the printed mark/item_no when one exists, otherwise a descriptive auto id (flagged per entry). Houses 08-11 already id every entry; 01-07 did not.
